tasks.title: Timed entry answers for the ticket page

steps.request: The Crowdgate SDK, the package crowdgate-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in CROWDGATE_API_KEY; the ticket page already books through it. When Crowdgate answers 409 with error slot_full, our ticket page must also get a 409, with the body { error: 'This time slot is full.' }, so it can show a friendly message. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

On busy mornings Crowdgate answers 429 with a retry-after header. Then our ticket page must get a 503 with the header Retry-After set to the seconds from Crowdgate's retry-after (30 when it sends none), and the body { error: 'Please try again in a moment.' }.
Groups of more than 10 visitors must book by phone: such a ticket answers 400 with the body { error: 'Groups over 10 book by phone.' } and nothing is held.
